_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only 3% of 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over the last 7 days and no confirmed breaker in ETF flows or momentum, the coil holds and Anxiety persists into the event.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing no edge; narrative implies a bottoming setup which would suggest UP but does not commit to a directional call, creating a split between trapped-chop and accumulation-framing
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed drops below 25 with VIX spiking above 70 and BTC momentum_30d rolling over below 40, shifting phase to Panic (24-31)
next_move.invalidated_if: etf_flows surge above 40 with stablecoin_growth turning positive and BTC momentum_30d holding above 50, shifting phase to Complacency or Disbelief
